title: Eddie Doc Review Format
description: Portable sidecar (<mapping>.review.json) mapping one annotated PDF's review marks back to AsciiDoc source. One file per mapping; mappings are grouped into revisions (editing rounds). Version 3.

$schema.description: Identifier of this format; the canonical URL is the $id above.

revision.description: The editing round this mapping belongs to.

mapping.description: What this mapping is and where its marks came from.

artifacts.description: Files produced from this mapping (reports, stamped PDFs), addressed relative to the sidecar.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent write.

source.description: The source .adoc, addressed relative to this sidecar.

pdf.description: The PDF this mapping was built from, addressed relative to this sidecar.

annotationCount.description: Number of annotations extracted from the PDF.

role.description: What kind of PDF this is. Absent means 'annotated'.

imported.description: True when the PDF was copied in beside this sidecar.

importedFrom.description: Where an imported PDF was copied from, relative to the sidecar.

revision.description: One round of editing. Every mapping that came back from the same pass over the manuscript shares a revision, however many editors contributed to it.

id.description: Folder id of the round, rev-<ordinal>. Unique per document.

ordinal.description: 1-based round number, as authors count them.

label.description: Human label for the round, e.g. 'Copyedit round 2'.

receivedAt.description: When the round came back — ISO-8601 date or date-time.

mapping.description: One annotated PDF mapped onto the source — the unit a sidecar records. Several mappings share a revision when a round came back from more than one place.

id.description: File-name stem of this sidecar; unique within its revision.

kind.description: How the mapping was produced. 'annotations': PDF annotations extracted and matched onto the source. 'manual': links made by hand with no annotation source.

origin.description: Where the marks came from — the publisher, agency or site.

reviewer.description: Person who made the marks, when known apart from the origin.

reviewType.description: The editorial pass this mapping represents.

pdfRole.description: What kind of PDF a mapping was built from. Only an 'annotated' one carries marks to map; 'clean' is a fresh render; 'stamped' is an Eddie Doc output carrying marks and replies.

artifact.description: A file produced from this mapping.

kind.description: What kind of file this is.

path.description: Path relative to the sidecar's directory, POSIX separators.
Path relative to the sidecar's directory, POSIX separators.

sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the file's bytes at map time.

bytes.description: File size in bytes at map time.

origin.description: Origin corner of PDF user space.

quadPoints.description: Optional per-line quad points, 8 numbers per quad.

annotation.description: Immutable, PDF-derived part of an item.

anchoredText.description: Text physically under the markup (over-captures a line for matching).

markedText.description: Tightly-bounded text inside the markup quads, for character-level edits.

beforeText.description: For caret/insert marks: text left of the caret on the same line.

match.description: Recomputable mapping onto the source. A cache, not authoritative.

method.description: How the match was produced. marker/blockId/fingerprint resolve an identity recorded in the source and are authoritative; fuzzy/semantic/lexical search for similar text and can be wrong.

sourceExcerpt.description: Non-authoritative snapshot of matched source text, for display only.

state.description: User-owned review state — the only part a human edits over time.

confirmed.description: User has vouched for the link (hand-picked or accepted a weak match).

stale.description: The text this link described is no longer recognisable: its anchor stopped resolving, or re-matching now scores materially worse than when the link was made. The item keeps its last known position and is routed to 'Needs review'; vouching for it or re-linking it clears the flag.

manualLine.description: 0-based line the user manually linked to; overrides match.

replies.description: The author's reply thread under this annotation, oldest first.

reply.description: One entry in an item's reply thread.

id.description: Stable id so an edit or delete addresses exactly one reply.

anchor.description: Durable binding of an item to a place in the source. Unlike match, these identities travel with the text itself, so they survive edits made outside the extension. Every field is optional; an un-anchored item omits the block entirely.

marker.description: Id of the `// eddie:<id>` marker comment injected into the source.

blockId.description: Id of the enclosing AsciiDoc block, e.g. ch04-figure-anatomy.

blockFingerprint.description: Truncated SHA-256 of the normalized enclosing block text at anchor time.

contextBefore.description: A few normalized words before the anchored block.

contextAfter.description: A few normalized words after the anchored block.

id.description: Stable id — the PDF annotation id when available, else page+geometry.
